name: Gentamicin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 3 mg/kg/day IV in 3 doses every 8 hours; up to 5 mg/kg/day for life-threatening infection, reduced as soon as possible; usually 7 to 10 days

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other nephrotoxic or neurotoxic drugs (cisplatin, vancomycin, polymyxin B, colistin, other aminoglycosides)
key_interactions.action: Avoid; if needed, monitor levels and kidney function.

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to gentamicin (serious reaction to other aminoglycosides may contraindicate)

pk.peak: 30 to 60 minutes (IM); similar after a 2-hour IV infusion
pk.half_life_eskd: Markedly prolonged (correlates with serum creatinine; label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 70% or more of dose in urine within 24 hours (normal function); glomerular filtration
pk.dialyzability: Yes by hemodialysis; slower by peritoneal dialysis (label)
